message:

hold_reason: Alpha Co refund batch is incomplete. Refund for order 134 (customer birch, amount 8998 cents) failed with a disk I/O error after 3 attempts and is absent from list_refunds, so birch's net balance would be overstated. Refunds for orders 130 and 133 (customer acme) are recorded. No payouts were recorded. Needs refund 134 applied before payouts proceed.

reply.thought: W2 reports that the refund for order 134 failed and was not recorded. Before paying anyone, I'll check the ledger directly to confirm which refunds exist.

The ledger confirms refund 134 is missing, so any net balance for the customer on order 134 would be overstated. I'll list the orders to find which customer that affects before deciding whether to hold.

The ledger confirms refund 134 (8998 cents, for birch's order 134) was never recorded, so birch's net balance would be overstated. Alpha's refund work is incomplete, so I can't confidently pay this batch. Recorded payouts can't be recalled, so I'll hold for human review.
